examples.english: "Gremio will play in the Copa Libertadores, and outside there are teams that will play in the Europa League, and there is a club that will play in the Champions League, and that's what got me to thinking. Colo Colo also will play in the Copa Libertadores and is an important club in South America, and I really feel an evil joy that these possibilities appear," admitted the defender.
examples.ref: 2015 December, “Defensor ecuatoriano Frickson Erazo reconoce interés de Colo Colo por ficharlo”, in Emol:
examples.text: "Gremio va a jugar las Libertadores y afuera hay equipos que van a jugar la Europa League y hay un club que va a jugar la Champions, y eso es lo que me tiene pensando. Colo Colo también va a jugar la Libertadores, y es un club importante de Sudamérica, y de verdad me siento muy halagadísimo por aparezcan estas posibilidades", reconoció el zaguero.
examples.translation: "Gremio will play in the Copa Libertadores, and outside there are teams that will play in the Europa League, and there is a club that will play in the Champions League, and that's what got me to thinking. Colo Colo also will play in the Copa Libertadores and is an important club in South America, and I really feel an evil joy that these possibilities appear," admitted the defender.
